company.description: The company name, copied from the intelligence profile.

subject.description: Short, specific, not salesy. No exclamation points.

first_email_angle.description: The short, punchy emotional bridge between the intelligence profile and this specific email - roughly 3-8 words. Usually a tactical rendering of colorkaar_angle, but chosen fresh for this outreach and free to draw on most_distinctive_insight or why_this_lead instead if that's the stronger hook this time. e.g. "Protecting the look established in camera."

body.description: The email body. Human, minimal, confident, founder-led, professional, relationship-first. Never salesy.

most_distinctive_insight_used.description: The most_distinctive_insight this email was actually built around.

conversation_starter_used.description: The conversation_starter this email opens with.

evidence_strength.description: Carried forward from the intelligence profile, adjusted if the email required more inference.

reasoning.description: One or two sentences on which parts of the intelligence profile the email was built around, and why. Debug only, dropped before export.
